name: sp-sync-agent
description: Small headless agent that serves Super Productivity's local REST API and syncs to a SuperSync server
//dependencies: Bundled into dist/main.js by esbuild, so these are BUILD-time requirements of the app sources this agent reuses, not runtime deps of the shipped file. @angular/compiler is required at RUNTIME: @ngrx/store and @angular/core ship partially compiled and fall back to the JIT compiler, which a bundle never links. Versions mirror the root manifest on purpose — a different Angular major here would break against the app sources.
//devDependencies: electron/electron-builder are the desktop packaging toolchain and are only needed to produce an installer. typescript and @types/node back the `typecheck` script; without them declared, `tsc` silently resolves from the repo root locally and is simply absent in a clean CI checkout.
